Alex (AE): Hey team — FalconEdge just pushed back, asking for an executive bridge. Main blockers: BYO-KMS attestation, a one-time pricing concession for the POC, and a tighter SLA for the dedicated pool. Need an internal quick sync and who can join the bridge with execs tomorrow morning?
Devin (SE): I can join as tech lead. POC is on Dedicated-e2, throughput looks good but they want KV cache persistency guarantee which we don't promise today.
Sam (Security): We finished the security questionnaire except the KMS attestation section — can provide our standard attestation doc, but FalconEdge needs confirmation on key rotation policy and separation of duties.
Jorge (Legal): For BYO-KMS we need to confirm legal language for KMS access & indemnity. If they require HSM-level SLAs, that's a separate legal review. Can you paste their asks here?
Alex (AE): Copied from their email: "1) BYO-KMS with customer-managed keys (no Redwood access) 2) 99.95% P95 latency SLA for the POC window 3) 30% discount on POC usage and committed pricing for first year"
Rita (VP Sales): 30% is steep for a POC. What's our net deal motion if we grant it? Are they trending to commit to Dedicated or Private?
Alex (AE): They're evaluating Dedicated for production if the POC meets latency + KMS. Likely multi-region later. ARR potential ~ $1.2M/yr.
Priya (CRO): If ARR looks real, we can consider an executive concession for the POC. I need an ask to present: exact discount %, duration, and any contractual guardrails (cap on credits, one-time vs recurring). Also who will present the technical mitigation for KMS?
Devin (SE): For BYO-KMS: we can support customer-managed keys with no plaintext key export. We need a short doc describing crypto flow. Marshall (Eng) can confirm if any infra changes are needed for the attestation.
Marshall (Eng): Quick read — we support BYO-KMS integration today but we need to lock down telemetry and audit access controls. No code changes for POC, just config + runbook. I can join the bridge.
Sam (Security): We can provide the attestation template. If they require cryptographic proof of rotation cadence, we can provide our policy but cannot attest to their KMS ops. For separation of duties we need the contract clause that prohibits Redwood from accessing customer-managed keys.
Jorge (Legal): Draft clause: "Customer maintains sole control of cryptographic keys; Redwood will not possess or derive customer key material and will not access keys without explicit written consent." I can draft an addendum. Who owns signoff?
Rita (VP Sales): Legal to draft, Priya to approve concession, Alex to send to customer. Ops: what timeline for the bridge?
Alex (AE): Proposed: exec bridge Wed 10:00am PST (they're in EST but flexible). I'll ask for CFO + CISO on their side. Can we confirm internal attendees?
Priya (CRO): I'll join. Rita — can you be on standby?
Rita (VP Sales): Yes, I can make it.
Devin (SE): I'll handle the demo and the KMS flow diagram. Marshall will back me.
Sam (Security): I'll join for the security Q&A and bring the attestation doc.
Jorge (Legal): I'll prepare the addendum draft and share before the bridge.
ops-bot: /create-bridge FalconEdge-exec-bridge Wed 2025-09-24 10:00 PST — Meeting room created: https://meet.redwood.internal/bridges/fe-bridge-2876543210
Alex (AE): Nice — putting together a short customer-facing email. DM me if you want to tweak language. Draft below — please comment: \n\nAlex (AE): ```\nSubject: Exec bridge — FalconEdge POC acceptance & KMS + SLA follow-up\nHi [CFO name],\n\nThanks for the sync earlier. To ensure the POC meets FalconEdge requirements, we'd like to schedule an executive bridge on Wed, Sep 24 at 10:00am PST. Goals: confirm BYO-KMS attestation language, review P95 latency targets and dedicated pool SLA, and align on POC commercial terms (trial credits / short-term concession).\n\nAttendees from Redwood: Alex (AE), Priya (CRO), Rita (VP Sales), Devin (SE), Sam (Security), Jorge (Legal), Marshall (Eng).\n\nPlease confirm if this time works and who from your side will join (CFO/CISO/CTO).\n\nBest,\nAlex\n```\n\nPriya (CRO): That email looks good. Add a single bullet with the specific concession ask: "30% POC discount capped at $25k in credits" — helps legal/finance scope it.
Devin (SE): Also add an appendix link to the KMS flow diagram and the attestation doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/kms-attestation-v1.pdf
Sam (Security): I'll upload the attestation to the doc link and flag sections that need cust confirmation.
Jorge (Legal): I'll draft the addendum and ping @Priya for review by EOD tomorrow.
Alex (AE): Quick checklist for the bridge: 1) Legal clause draft, 2) KMS flow diagram + attestation, 3) proposed POC credit cap & discount, 4) SLA ask phrasing, 5) demo script for latency tests. Who owns each?
Devin (SE): Demo script + flow diagram = Devin/Marshall
Sam (Security): Attestation upload + security Qs = Sam
Jorge (Legal): Addendum draft = Jorge
Priya (CRO): Concession approval & framing = Priya
Rita (VP Sales): Pricing contingency and exec messaging = Rita
Alex (AE): Great. I'll hit send to the customer after Legal shares the addendum. Can someone push the discount approval through finance?
Priya (CRO): @Rita, can you loop Finance and get pre-approval for the $25k cap? We want to avoid last-minute blocks.
Rita (VP Sales): I'll loop in finance and Ops and get back within 6 hours.
Marshall (Eng): Small note — to demonstrate P95 we should pre-run the load tests and capture traces. I'll schedule a run today.
Alex (AE): Thanks all. If anyone can't make the bridge, please signal now. Otherwise I'll send the invite and customer email after EOD when we have the addendum and discount confirmation. :thumbsup:
Priya (CRO): Summary / owners - Exec bridge Wed 10am PST; Legal (Jorge) to draft addendum; Security (Sam) to publish attestation; Dev (Devin/Marshall) to prepare demo + traces; Sales (Rita/Alex) to confirm pricing cap with Finance. I'll escalate to the exec sponsor if we need a faster approval.
Rita (VP Sales): On it.
Alex (AE): Closing loop — sending invite in 30m.
